Jonah Reed: Quick note from the q4b-int8 bring-up: human-eval golden precision dropped ~3.2% even though automated holdout recall improved. suspect either quant tiling/softmax change or accidental anchor reuse. anyone on curation?
Priya Singh: hm. did the rollout include the new int8-v3 kernels? that changed fused-softmax ordering last week.
Hannah Kim: yes int8-v3 went to the bench cluster yesterday. but we also merged an anchor-promotion script that had lax origin checks. could be both.
Diego Alvarez: can we triage fast: 1) run fingerprint overlap of anchors vs active; 2) run eval with int8-v2 binary; 3) sample 100 flagged anchors for manual check.
Jonah Reed: doing 1) now. SQL I run locally for exact fp overlap:
```
SELECT a.anchor_id, s.id FROM anchors a
JOIN samples s ON a.fingerprint = s.fingerprint
WHERE a.created_at > '2025-01-01' LIMIT 200;
```
ci-bot: job fp-overlap-3805550000 started by Jonah Reed at 2025-06-18T11:03:12Z
Priya Singh: running an abbreviated stratified near-dup pass too (minhash + token buckets). will post counts.
Hannah Kim: if anchors came from synthesis we should quarantine and snapshot current golden before any rollouts. Diego, can you spin up int8-v2 eval?
Diego Alvarez: spawning int8-v2 eval against holdout now. ETA ~14m.
Priya Singh: near-dup summary: 1.8% of active flagged; anchor overlap reduced to 0.12% after removing exact fps, but ~1.1% paraphrase clusters include anchors (mostly >1024 tokens).
Jonah Reed: thanks. running the manual sample selection tool now: `python tools/sample_review.py --source anchors --seed 42 --n 100 --out review_380555.json`
ci-bot: job eval-int8v2-3805550000 started by Diego Alvarez at 2025-06-18T11:10:05Z
Diego Alvarez: int8-v2 eval done: golden precision recovered to within 0.5% and recall also normal. points to dataset leakage + kernel change amplification.
Hannah Kim: action items: - quarantine paraphrase clusters containing anchors - block auto-promotion of synth-origin samples - add bring-up gate: anchor overlap < 0.5% or fail.
Priya Singh: creating ticket MLC-5033 for nightly fingerprint sweep + anchor-promotion policy.
Jonah Reed: I'll run manual micro-audit on the 100 samples this afternoon and attach findings to the ticket. thanks team :+1:
